sentences.en: People were delighted at the safe return of the astronauts.
sentences.zh: 人们为宇航员安全返回而感到高兴。

sentences.en: The speech made by the president yesterday delighted his supporters.
sentences.zh: 总统昨天发表的演讲让他的支持者们欣喜若狂。

sentences.en: He was delighted to know I had passed the exam.
sentences.zh: 得知我通过了考试，他非常开心。

senses.zh: 高兴的；令人愉快的；乐意的
（使）高兴，愉快（delight 的过去式及过去分词）
